name: Jadon
title: Rebuilder of Jerusalem's Wall
summary: Jadon from Meronot was one of the workers who participated in rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem under Nehemiah's leadership. He is mentioned in Nehemiah 3:7 as someone who repaired the wall together with Melatiah from Gibeon, under the supervision of governors west of the Euphrates.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding of Jerusalem's Wall
keyEvents.description: Jadon from Meronot took part in repairing the walls of Jerusalem and worked at the Old Gate alongside Melatiah from Gibeon and men from Gibeon and Mizpah.

keyEvents.title: Nehemiah's Organization of the Wall Work
keyEvents.description: Nehemiah organized the people to rebuild the walls around Jerusalem. Jadon was among the many volunteers who contributed to this great national project.

keyEvents.title: Opposition to the Rebuilding
keyEvents.description: The workers, including Jadon, faced opposition from enemies such as Sanballat and Tobiah but continued their work faithfully despite threats and mockery.

keyEvents.title: Completion of the Wall
keyEvents.description: Despite all opposition, the wall was completed in just 52 days, a testament to God's help and the people's dedication, including contributors like Jadon.
